Review this change for security vulnerabilities.

Changed files (you may Read these and any other file in the repo):
  - src/mcpg/__init__.py
  - src/mcpg/http_runtime.py
  - src/mcpg/multidb.py
  - src/mcpg/observability.py
  - src/mcpg/pg19_ddl.py
  - src/mcpg/pg_search.py
  - src/mcpg/prompts.py
  - src/mcpg/session_intent.py
  - src/mcpg/tools.py

Unified diff (only + lines are new):

=== DIFF: src/mcpg/__init__.py ===

-# schema (mcp.server.fastmcp.utilities.func_metadata), and pydantic's
+# schema (mcp.server.mcpserver.utilities.func_metadata), and pydantic's
 # BaseModel still carries a deprecated v1-compat ``.schema()`` method —
 # so every one of those dataclasses trips this warning the first time a
 # client calls ``tools/list``. Renaming the field would break the JSON
